next.reason: 1985: 'The currency symbol must be the leftmost character position ... except that it can be preceded by either a '+' or a '-''. §2023:13.18.40.3 SR26 also allows it as 'the rightmost symbol in character-string-1, optionally followed by one of the symbols '+', '-', 'CR', or 'DB'', so PIC 999$ and 999$CR, refused in 1985, are accepted (looser). The one-symbol limits (§2023:13.18.40.3 SR23, SR24), sign position (§2023:13.18.40.3 SR25), CR/DB size (§2023:13.18.40.4 GR14) and the result table (§2023:13.18.40.5 GR5) are unchanged.
